```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(limpa)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ade4)
library(adegraphics)
library(mixOmics)
library(caret)
library("randomForest")
library(pROC)

y.peptide <- readDIANN("~/work/DIANN_1_9_PRATEG_serie2/report.tsv")

metadata_all = read.xlsx("~/work/Cohorte 2_Synthèse TE PRATEG - Corrigé.xlsx",sheet=2)[1:206,]


metadata_all$ID.receveuse[metadata_all$ID.receveuse=="FR5502758014"] = "FR5502750001"
metadata_all$ID.receveuse[metadata_all$ID.receveuse=="FR4321815388"] = "FR4321810002"
metadata_all$ID.receveuse[metadata_all$ID.receveuse=="FR5502730548"] = "FR5502730003"

metadata_all$code_num = substr(metadata_all$ID.receveuse, nchar(metadata_all$ID.receveuse) - 3, nchar(metadata_all$ID.receveuse))

colnames(y.peptide$E)[colnames(y.peptide$E)=="5-31-2025_93_8014_G_12536"]="5-31-2025_93_0001_G_12536"
colnames(y.peptide$E)[colnames(y.peptide$E)=="4-26-2025_134_5388_NG_12062"]="4-26-2025_134_0002_NG_12062"
colnames(y.peptide$E)[colnames(y.peptide$E)=="6-2-2025_175_0548_NG_12600"]="6-2-2025_175_0003_NG_12600"
colnames(y.peptide$E)[colnames(y.peptide$E)=="5-30-2025_113_08437_PE_12511"]="5-30-2025_113_8437_PE_12511"

sample_all = colnames(y.peptide$E)

sample = as.data.frame(colnames(y.peptide$E))
colnames(sample) = "sample_ID"

sample_mat = data.frame()

for (i in sample$sample_ID){
  code_num = (str_split(i, "_")[[1]])[3]
  sample_mat = rbind(sample_mat, c(i,code_num))
  
}

names(sample_mat) = c("sample_ID", "code_num")

metadata = merge(sample_mat,metadata_all,by = "code_num",sort = FALSE)
metadata$Date.du.TE = as.Date(metadata$Date.du.TE, origin = "1899-12-30")
metadata$Date.du.TE = format(metadata$Date.du.TE, "%m-%d-%Y")

metadata$code_num = substr(metadata$ID.receveuse, nchar(metadata$ID.receveuse)-3,nchar(metadata$ID.receveuse))

tmetadata = metadata

metadata$Catégories = ifelse(metadata$Catégories == "NR", "NG", "G")



y.peptide$E = y.peptide$E[,metadata$sample_ID]

y.peptide <- filterNonProteotypicPeptides(y.peptide)
y.peptide <- filterCompoundProteins(y.peptide)

dpcfit <- dpc(y.peptide)

y.protein <- dpcQuant(y.peptide, protein.id = "Protein.Group", dpc=dpcfit)

y.protein$E = y.protein$E[!grepl("conta\\|", rownames(y.protein$E)),]
y.protein$E = y.protein$E[,metadata$sample_ID]

M.pca <- dudi.pca(y.protein$E,scale=T,center=T,scannf=F,nf=4)

s.class(M.pca$co,fac=as.factor(metadata$Catégories),col=2:6)
index = order(M.pca$co[,1], decreasing = T)[1:3]

y.protein$E = y.protein$E[,-index]
y.peptide$E = y.peptide$E[,-index]
metadata = metadata[-index,]

```

Vitro seulement

```{r}
metadatavitro = metadata[which(metadata$Nature.embryon == "VITRO"),]
y.vitro = y.protein$E[,metadatavitro$sample_ID]
y.vitro = y.vitro[,metadatavitro$sample_ID]

M.pca <- dudi.pca(y.vitro,scale=T,center=T,scannf=F,nf=4)
s.class(M.pca$co,fac=as.factor(metadatavitro$Catégories),col=2:6)

set.seed(1312)
vitrovalidindex = createDataPartition(y = metadatavitro$Catégories, p = 0.3, list = F)
data_valid_vitro = y.vitro[,vitrovalidindex]
metadata_valid_vitro = metadatavitro[vitrovalidindex,]

data_ID_vitro = y.vitro[,-vitrovalidindex]
metadata_ID_vitro = metadatavitro[-vitrovalidindex,]

```

```{r}
control = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, classProbs = T, summaryFunction = twoClassSummary, verbose = FALSE, savePredictions = "final")

proteines = NULL

X = t(data_ID_vitro)
Y = as.factor(metadata_ID_vitro$Catégories)

GvitroID = which(metadata_ID_vitro$Catégories == "G")
NGvitroID = which(metadata_ID_vitro$Catégories == "NG")

runiter = function(i){

  train_index = createDataPartition(y = Y, p = 0.70, list = F)
  
  train_X = data.frame(X[train_index,])
  test_X = X[-train_index,]
  
  train_Y = Y[train_index]
  test_Y = Y[-train_index]
  
  set.seed(1312)
  tuned = tune.splsda(train_X, train_Y, test.keepX = c(1:30), ncomp = 2, validation = "Mfold",folds = 5, nrepeat = 10, dist = "max.dist", measure = "BER")
  
  best = tuned$choice.keepX
  
  res = mixOmics::splsda(train_X, train_Y, keepX = best)
  
  prot = c(selectVar(res, comp = 1)$name,selectVar(res, comp = 2)$name)
  
  return(prot)
}

library(future)
library(future.apply)
nb_cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1
plan(multisession, workers = nb_cores)

set.seed(1312)
results = future_lapply(1:50, runiter, future.seed = T)

proteines = unlist(results)

a = data.frame(table(proteines))
good_prot = rownames(data.frame(which(table(proteines) >= 30)))
good_prot

h = hist(a$Freq, breaks = 50, xlab = "Fréquence de sélection", ylab = "Nombre d'ARNs", main = "")
h = hist(a$Freq, breaks = 50, xlab = "Fréquence de sélection", ylab = "Nombre d'ARNs", main = "", ylim = c(0,max(h$counts)+10))
abline(v= 30, col = "red")
abline(v = 25, col= "blue")

etiquettes = ifelse(h$counts>0, h$counts, "")
text(x = h$mids,y=h$counts,labels = etiquettes, pos = 3, font = 2, col = "black", cex = 0.8)
legend("topright", legend = c("Seuil à 52% (blue)", "Seuil à 60% (red)"), col = c("blue","red"), lty = 1, lwd = 2, bty = "o")
```

```{r}
control = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, classProbs = T, summaryFunction = twoClassSummary, verbose = FALSE, savePredictions = "final")

data_IDtrain = as.data.frame(t(data_ID_vitro[good_prot,]))
data_validfinal = as.data.frame(t(data_valid_vitro[good_prot,]))
grid.rf = expand.grid(mtry = 2)

#protc1 = read.table("protc1")$x

#data_IDtrain = as.data.frame(t(data_ID_vitro[protc1,]))
#data_validfinal = as.data.frame(t(data_valid_vitro[protc1,]))
#grid.rf = expand.grid(mtry = c(3,4))

set.seed(1312)
modele_rf = train(x = data_IDtrain,y = metadata_ID_vitro$Catégories, method = "rf", metric = "ROC", trControl = control, tuneGrid = grid.rf)
```

```{r}
predclass = predict(modele_rf, newdata = data_validfinal)
predprob = predict(modele_rf, newdata = data_validfinal, type = "prob")

res = confusionMatrix(predclass, as.factor(metadata_valid_vitro$Catégories))
print(res)

probG = predprob[,"G"]

objectroc = roc(response = as.factor(metadata_valid_vitro$Catégories), predictor = probG, levels = c("NG", "G"))
coords_ideal = coords(objectroc, x= "all", ret = c("threshold", "specificity", "sensitivity"))
seuil = coords_ideal[coords_ideal$specificity == 1,]
seuil = min(seuil$threshold)

seuil

ajusted = ifelse(probG > seuil, "G","NG")
res2 = confusionMatrix(as.factor(ajusted), as.factor(metadata_valid_vitro$Catégories))
print(res2)

threshsens = coords_ideal[,c("threshold","sensitivity")]
threshspe = coords_ideal[,c("threshold","specificity")]
plot(threshsens, type = "l", col = "blue",ylab = "Sensitivity & Specificity")
lines(threshspe, type = "l", col = "red")
legend("right", legend = c("Sensitivity", "Specificity"), col = c("blue","red"), lty = 1, lwd = 2, bty = "o")



plot(objectroc)


rownames(tmetadata) = tmetadata$sample_ID

recap = data.frame("Echantillon" = rownames(data_validfinal), "Classe" = tmetadata[rownames(data_validfinal),"Catégories"], "Probabilité" = probG)

library(tidyverse)
thresholds = seq(0,1, by =0.01)

df_evo = map_dfr(thresholds, function(t){
  recap %>%
    group_by(Classe)%>%
    summarise(
      prop_gestante = sum(Probabilité >= t),
              nb_total = n(),
              .groups = "drop"
    )%>%
    mutate(seuil = t)
})

ggplot(df_evo, aes(x = seuil, y = prop_gestante, color = Classe))+
  geom_line(size = 1.2)
```

```{r}
nas = NULL
gnas = NULL
ngnas = NULL
protexprG = NULL
protexprNG = NULL

y.peptidevivo = y.peptide[,metadatavivo$sample_ID]
y.peptidevitro = y.peptide[,metadatavitro$sample_ID]

#In vivo
for(i in good_protvivo){
  peptides = rownames(y.peptidevivo$genes[which(y.peptidevivo$genes$Protein.Group == i),])
  don.peptides = y.peptidevivo$E[which(rownames(y.peptidevivo$E) %in% peptides),]
  nas = c(nas,mean(is.na(don.peptides)))
  gnas = c(gnas,mean(is.na(don.peptides[which(metadatavivo$Catégories == "G")])))
  ngnas = c(ngnas,mean(is.na(don.peptides[which(metadatavivo$Catégories != "G")])))
  protexprG = c(protexprG,median(y.vivo[i,which(metadatavivo$Catégories == "G")]))
  protexprNG = c(protexprNG,median(y.vivo[i,which(metadatavivo$Catégories != "G")]))
}

propna = data.frame("Proteine" = good_protvivo, "Mean NA" = nas, "Mean NA G"= gnas, "Mean NA NG"= ngnas,"Mean Expr G" = protexprG, "Mean Expr NG" = protexprNG)



nas = NULL
gnas = NULL
ngnas = NULL
protexprG = NULL
protexprNG = NULL
#In vitro
for(i in good_prot){
  peptides = rownames(y.peptidevitro$genes[which(y.peptidevitro$genes$Protein.Group == i),])
  don.peptides = y.peptidevitro$E[which(rownames(y.peptidevitro$E) %in% peptides),]
  nas = c(nas,mean(is.na(don.peptides)))
  gnas = c(gnas,mean(is.na(don.peptides[which(metadatavitro$Catégories == "G")])))
  ngnas = c(ngnas,mean(is.na(don.peptides[which(metadatavitro$Catégories != "G")])))
  protexprG = c(protexprG,mean(y.vitro[i,which(metadatavitro$Catégories == "G")]))
  protexprNG = c(protexprNG,mean(y.vitro[i,which(metadatavitro$Catégories != "G")]))
}


propnavitro = data.frame("Proteine" = good_prot, "Mean NA" = nas, "Mean NA G"= gnas, "Mean NA NG"= ngnas, "Mean Expr G" = protexprG, "Mean Expr NG" = protexprNG)
```
